# Story & Narrative

@id: design.story
@labels: design, narrative, p2
@created: 2024-01-15

## Description

Game narrative, character backstory, and world building. Story is conveyed through environmental storytelling and brief cutscenes rather than extensive dialogue.

@agent-note: NPC dialogue has been waived to focus on core gameplay. Story beats should be deliverable through visual storytelling.

## Tasks

- [ ] Write main storyline
  - Story conveyed via 3-5 second cutscenes between worlds
  - Opening: village destroyed, hero seeks revenge
  - Ending: two versions (good/bad) based on collectible count

  - [ ] World 1 story beats
  - [ ] World 2 story beats
  - [ ] Ending narrative

  - Bosses: each represents a corrupted element (nature, earth, fire)
  - [ ] Player character origin
  - [ ] Boss character motivations
- [ ] Create world lore
